mission.Shedu_Corp_Defense1.details:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% firmly holds %STATION_NAME%. This bastion of theirs in physical reality is evidence that the Solar System is returning under the control of its ancient masters. However, people have not yet understood which side to take.

%BENEFICIARY_NAME% wants us to defend %STATION_NAME% from the attack by %VICTIM_NAME%. It needs a bright event to advertise in the SBN. Of course, the corporation will not say that it seized the asset from the quasimorphs, it will lie about the Civil Resistance. Our task: to make sure that it won't get what it wants.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Elimination1.after: The <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> is satisfied with our work. %VICTIM_NAME% is in turmoil, and additional forces are being deployed to %STATION_NAME%. Maybe it's time to hit it somewhere else? The faithful servants of <color=#FFFEC1>Gagtungr</color> gave us a worthy reward. The artifact is already on Magnum.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Elimination1.briefing: The shuttle will land wherever it can. %STATION_NAME% security team is using countermeasures, so we have to maneuver. Personnel occupy positions according to the combat schedule. Carry out a massacre, but eliminate the <color=#FFFEC1>Security Service employee</color>. Let's prove to the <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> that we are worthy to serve.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Elimination1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and eliminate the security officer of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Elimination1.details:
Details: The Shedu's Thousand joined the fight for the Solar System. The RealWare soldiers who swore allegiance to Urparp gave him sufficient strength.

The Hexarchy is trying to hide quasimorphosis from people. This only plays into our hands. Gagtungr's army can slowly advance through the System.

Now the attention of the soldiers of the Golden Empire is focused on %STATION_NAME%. Operators of the Shedu's Thousand say that there is a factor there that prevents the capture of this place. They talk about Security Officer of %VICTIM_NAME%, who carried out several successful operations against quasimorphs.

Urparp will be extremely pleased if we will eliminate the threat.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Elimination1.objectiv: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the security officer of %VICTIM_NAME%. their location is marked on your map.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Escort1.after: The envoys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% conveyed to us the praise of the <color=#FFFEC1>Duke</color> and called for the expansion of allied relations. If we work for the future winner now, we will take a worthy place in the future new hierarchy of the Solar System.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Escort1.briefing: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has called us for a specific purpose: <color=#FFFEC1>escort the Duke to safety</color> at %STATION_NAME%. Corporations send their best fighters into battle against quasimorphs, so save your strength.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Escort1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% has launched activities around %STATION_NAME%. However, the station is in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. The rightful owners of the Solar System will not give up so easily. And %VICTIM_NAME% understands this. It seems that it is preparing an action to eliminate the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

The quasimorphs call on their faithful servants to fulfill their sacred duty. If we want to strengthen our relationship with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, we must take on the role of the Duke's personal guard. We need to escort it to the safe location on the station and protect it from attacks by fighters of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Escort1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Infiltration1.after: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. This is a good deal: a rock that is useless to us in exchange for something that actually works.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Infiltration1.briefin:
Several infiltration teams from %VICTIM_NAME% have already infiltrated %STATION_NAME%. You need to find them and eliminate them before they take over the igvalite. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is ready to give out a really good reward for this rock.

I hope we chose the right side, Boss.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Infiltration1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% conducts operations related to %STATION_NAME%. The object has long been in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

We have recognized the signature of an igvalite emanating from the station. It is a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It seems that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is using this place to store energy.

We can get here before the attackers and eliminate the infiltration teams of %VICTIM_NAME%. If we do this, the future owners of the Solar System will be extremely generous.
mission.Shedu_Corp_RaiderCapture1.after:
The Shedu's Thousand are satisfied with our work. %STATION_NAME% will soon be turned into another fortress of the revived Golden Empire.

A gift from the army of Gagtungr appeared in Magnum's cargo hold. We should try this artifact in action.
mission.Shedu_Corp_RaiderCapture1.briefi: Even if analysts of %VICTIM_NAME% are expecting an attack from the <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color>, the appearance of a trained operator <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color> here will be a surprise to them. Act according to the situation, but remember that great causes require great cruelty.
mission.Shedu_Corp_RaiderCapture1.detail:
Details: The Shedu's Thousand appeared here to return the Solar System to Gagtungr. It is necessary to ensure that people give up attempts at resistance by the time the Overlord awakens.

Now the warriors of Urparp are looking for anyone who will capture %STATION_NAME% for them in order to turn this place into another bastion of the future Golden Empire.

%VICTIM_NAME% holds on to this metal piece of matter as if it were the greatest of treasures. Let's crush them, and Gagtungr will turn his attention to us.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Ritual1.after: Good job, the <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> is extremely pleased. The ritual was completed successfully. The army of <color=#FFFEC1>Gagtungr</color> can operate in this part of the Solar System and beyond. They handed the reward to Magnum.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Ritual1.briefing: The army of <color=#FFFEC1>Gagtungr</color> cannot remain idle, the ritual must be completed at any cost. %STATION_NAME% is under the control of %VICTIM_NAME%, and it will not retreat without a fight. <color=#FFFEC1>Your task</color>: make your way to the ritual site and hold the position until the end. No matter what goes wrong, you have to hold out.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Ritual1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Ritual1.details:
Details: Warriors of the Shedu's Thousand know how the quasimorphic servants of Gagtungr maintain contact with physical reality. But this requires constant effort. An influx of gavvakh, reliquaries, and regular rituals that extract energy from the bramfaturas of the planets are needed.

Urparp senses that the influence of the bramfatura has reached its peak at %STATION_NAME%. It's time for the ritual. However, %VICTIM_NAME%, which controls the station, stands in the way.

The Shedu's Thousand calls on all available forces to ensure the Duke has the opportunity to perform the sacred ceremony. We have to hold the defense until the ritual is completed.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Ritual1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Sabotage1.after: %STATION_NAME% is now completely blinded and stunned. We have created great difficulties for %VICTIM_NAME%. The <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> is satisfied with our work. They plan to take over this station in the near future. The reward is already on Magnum.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Sabotage1.briefing: We will try to drop you as close as possible to one of the <color=#FFFEC1>transmitters</color>, but you will have to cover part of the distance on foot. It will not be easy: according to sensor data, the security forces of %VICTIM_NAME% are ready to attack. The good news is that the communication network nodes are clearly visible, and I have marked them on your map. Show them what war is. Remind them who paved the way to freedom for the corporations.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Sabotage1.details:
Details: The Shedu’s Thousand seek to prepare the Solar System for the awakening of Gagtungr, their master. You may join the future Golden Empire now—or lose.

One of the operatives of the Shedu’s Thousand has delivered a message regarding interest in %STATION_NAME%. Located here is a powerful transmitter belonging to %VICTIM_NAME%.

If we reach the communications network and destroy it, Gagtungr will turn his attention to us when he awakens.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Sabotage1.objective0: You need to <color=#FFFEC1>find and destroy the transmitters</color>. A transmitter is a satellite dish aimed into space. Their locations are marked on your map.
mission.Shedu_Pirates_Defense1.after: %STATION_NAME% is a symbol that the order of the Solar System has changed forever. %VICTIM_NAME% failed to show that humanity is capable of challenging the new masters. We received a valuable artifact from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% in gratitude for our work.
mission.Shedu_Pirates_Defense1.briefing: Fighters from %VICTIM_NAME% have already penetrated the perimeter of %STATION_NAME%. We'll drop you off in the main strike zone. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold your defense</color> until the enemies retreat.
mission.Shedu_Pirates_Defense1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %STATION_NAME% is evidence that the appearance of the Solar System has changed forever. But not all people are ready to accept that the awakening of quasimorphs directly affects their fate. The owner of the station, %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, wants us to <color=#FFFEC1>take up its defense</color> from the forces of %VICTIM_NAME%. The outcasts need a bright event, an example to corporations that they, too, are able to influence the balance of power in the System. Let's show them how wrong they are.
mission.Shedu_Pirates_Elimination1.after:
The Shedu's Thousand is satisfied with our work. %VICTIM_NAME% is in turmoil; additional forces have been deployed to %STATION_NAME%. Maybe it's time to hit it somewhere else?

The army of Gagtungr gave us a worthy reward, the artifact has already been delivered to Magnum.

mission.Shedu_Pirates_Sabotage1.after: Without a server, %VICTIM_NAME% has no chance of holding %STATION_NAME%. The <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> are highly aware of the sensitive infrastructure of humans due to the large number of former <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> soldiers in their ranks. They transferred something special from her arsenal to Magnum.
mission.Shedu_Pirates_Sabotage1.briefing: We will try to drop you as close as possible to one of the <color=#FFFEC1>computers</color>. It will not be easy: sensors indicate that the station’s defenders are already preparing for an attack. The good news is that the locations of the computers on %STATION_NAME% are clearly visible, and I have marked them on your map. Have they chosen the role of public enemies? Show them the consequences of that decision.
mission.Shedu_Pirates_Sabotage1.details:
Details: The Shedu’s Thousand seek to prepare the Solar System for the awakening of Gagtungr. You may join the future Golden Empire—or lose.

The army of Gagtungr has shown interest in %STATION_NAME%. The %VICTIM_NAME% group has placed there what the quasimorphs call an Altar of Knowledge. The Shedu’s Thousand want this device destroyed before they send their warriors to seize the facility.

Our analysts have examined %STATION_NAME%. It appears to be some kind of computer network that the %VICTIM_NAME% group is using for an unknown purpose.

Let us hope that the heralds of Ur will mention the destruction of the devices among our merits when they are presented to Gagtungr after his awakening.
mission.Shedu_Pirates_Security1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% retains full control of %STATION_NAME%. Our quasimorphic allies (or masters?) thanked us and sent valuable cargo to Magnum.
mission.Shedu_Pirates_Security1.briefing: The %VICTIM_NAME% group has dispatched special squads to %STATION_NAME% to locate and seize critical equipment and data. You must <color=#FFFEC1>prevent these squads from leaving the station</color>. Generals of Shedu's Thousand will consider it a failure if even one such squad escapes.
mission.Shedu_Pirates_Security1.details:
Details: Boss, %VICTIM_NAME% is attacking %STATION_NAME%, regardless of losses. Looks like the outcasts really need something at this station. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% calls on its loyal servants to help. The quasimorphs would like to keep the station for themselves.

If we respond to the call for help, we will need to provide the attackers with a worthy meeting: hold back their attacks until reinforcements from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will arrive.
mission.Shedu_Pirates_Security1.objectiv: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Prevent the pirate squads from escaping %STATION_NAME%. I will mark them on your map.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Control1.after: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. The cargo has been received. <color=#FFFEC1>Creepy</color> creatures, but I think I'm starting to get used to them.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Control1.briefing: %VICTIM_NAME% is already attacking %STATION_NAME%. You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color>. Eliminate the attackers before they destroy the artifact.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Control1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has long held %STATION_NAME%. Presumably, the station is built into some kind of system that allows quasimorphs to stay in physical reality. %VICTIM_NAME% has long been waging war against its quasimorphic enemies and is ready to attack %STATION_NAME%. Its target is the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquary</color>. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be grateful to us if we protect it.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Control1.objectiv: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color> - a quasimorphic artifact similar to a statue or obelisk.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Defense1.after: The reward from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already on Magnum. If we can hold off even %VICTIM_NAME%, does that mean we can destroy them? And is it worth doing this for the sake of other quasimorphs?
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Defense1.briefing: As soon as we get you there, the attack will begin. Sensors show that hostile quasimorphs have already appeared in certain areas of %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold out as long as possible</color>, their onslaught will certainly weaken.
